claim.quote: a NaI crystal operated as a scintillating calorimeter at milli-Kelvin temperatures simultaneously providing a phonon (heat) plus scintillation light signal and particle discrimination on an event-by-event basis.

name: Results from the first cryogenic NaI detector for the COSINUS project

summary.plain: The first sodium iodide crystal run as a cryogenic detector for COSINUS, reading heat and light at millikelvin temperatures at once and telling particle types apart event by event.
summary.technical: First COSINUS NaI prototype (scintillating calorimeter at mK temperatures, phonon plus light): evaluation of energy resolution, threshold and other performance parameters (JINST 12, P11007).

title: Results from the first cryogenic NaI detector for the COSINUS project
why_it_matters: It is the first demonstration of the technique that COSINUS builds on.
